lines.zh: 我贴着沙面小跑，鳞片发烫。
lines.en: I trot low over the sand, my scales hot.

lines.zh: 尾巴在沙上拖出一道沟。
lines.en: My tail drags a groove through the sand.

lines.zh: 我的脚趾张开，不容易陷。
lines.en: My toes spread so I do not sink.
I cross the red dirt belt of the badlands.
On the dunes I walk in zigzags.

lines.zh: 我停下来，抖了抖背上的沙。
lines.en: I stop and shake the sand off my back.
Too hot; I keep to the shade.

lines.zh: 我四条腿倒得快，看着乱。
lines.en: My four legs scurry fast; it looks chaotic.

lines.zh: 我踩碎了地上的一层盐壳。
lines.en: I crack the salt crust underfoot.
I follow the floor of the dry lake.

lines.zh: 沙子从我的爪缝漏下去。
lines.en: Sand leaks down between my claws.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边吐着舌头。
lines.en: I walk along with my tongue out.

lines.zh: 我在石头上摊平身子晒太阳。
lines.en: I flatten myself on a rock to sunbathe.
My throat puffs out once.
I flick my tongue out and draw it back.

lines.zh: 这片沙太烫，我抬着一只脚。
lines.en: The sand burns; I hold one foot up.
I scratch out a shallow pit.

lines.zh: 细沙钻进鳞片，痒得我直抖。
lines.en: Fine sand works under my scales and itches.
I stare at a rabbit in the distance.

lines.zh: 尾巴尖一下一下敲着沙。
lines.en: My tail tip taps the sand, beat by beat.

lines.zh: 恶地的红岩在我背后发亮。
lines.en: Red badland rock glows behind me.
I hiccup and puff out a little hot air.
You are standing on my sand.
I raise my head to see how tall you are.

lines.zh: 你的影子正好给我遮阳。
lines.en: Your shadow shades me nicely.
I do not blink; lizards do not blink.

lines.zh: 你脚边有只鸡，我看见了。
lines.en: There is a chicken by your feet; I see it.
You want to ride me? Feed me first.
My scales are harder than your armor.

lines.zh: 你一缩脚，我的头就抬起来。
lines.en: You flinch a foot, and my head lifts.
I tilt my head and my throat clicks.

lines.zh: 沙漠里很少有人站这么久。
lines.en: Few people stand this long in the desert.

lines.zh: 鳞片裂了，露出底下的软皮。
lines.en: A scale splits and shows the soft skin under.
I hiss and sink down toward the sand.
That one hit my tail.

lines.zh: 我掉头就跑，跑了两步又停。
lines.en: I bolt two steps, then stop.
Blood and sand make a sticky mess.
My leg will not push properly.
Who is striking my back?
I roll once across the sand.
Do not think a small lizard will not bite.
My throat pumps as I pant.
Rabbit meat suits me best.
Chicken works, as long as you pluck it.
Pumpkin is sweet; I eat it sometimes.
Rotten flesh does not offend me.

lines.zh: 我慢慢爬过去，眼睛没离开。
lines.en: I crawl over, eyes never leaving it.

lines.zh: 蹲下来喂我，我脖子没那么长。
lines.en: Crouch to feed me; my neck is short.

lines.zh: 我一口咬走，连你的指头差点。
lines.en: One snap, and your finger nearly went too.
Once fed, I run faster.
That smell sets my tail swinging.

lines.zh: 再给我一块，我让你绑鞍。
lines.en: One more piece and you may saddle me.

lines.zh: 尾巴被你踩住，我回头瞪你。
lines.en: You have my tail pinned; I glare back.

lines.zh: 我冲过来，脑袋磕在你的护膝上。
lines.en: I charge and crack my skull on your knee guard.

lines.zh: 我侧过身，鳞片刮了你一下。
lines.en: I turn and my scales scrape across you.
Our scuffling kicks up a cloud of sand.

lines.zh: 脚抬起来，我的牙不长眼。
lines.en: Lift that foot; my teeth do not aim.
I dart through between your legs.

lines.zh: 两个影子在沙上撞在一起。
lines.en: Two shadows collide on the sand.
I shift aside to share the shade.
My back brushes against your trouser leg.
You are on my claw; lift your foot.

lines.zh: 我在最热的岩石上等你。
lines.en: I wait on the hottest rock.
Rabbit meat and pumpkin, all laid out.
We lie side by side on the sand.

lines.zh: 我用下巴蹭了蹭滚烫的沙。
lines.en: I rub my chin against the scalding sand.

lines.zh: 这片沙丘的洞是我挖的。
lines.en: I dug the burrow in this dune.
Step farther back; we are shy.

lines.zh: 我的鳞色在阳光下变了。
lines.en: My scales change color in the sunlight.
A clutch of eggs lies deep under the sand.
We doze pressed together.
The warmth under the sand will hatch them.
I take a bone in my jaws.

lines.zh: 这东西塞不进我的鞍袋。
lines.en: This will not fit in my saddlebag.

lines.zh: 你掉的铁镐，我拖进沙丘洞。
lines.en: Your dropped pickaxe is going into my burrow.

lines.zh: 我衔着它，跑得歪歪扭扭。
lines.en: Carrying it, I run crooked.
I can carry only six slots' worth.

lines.zh: 沙里有块亮东西，我挖出来。
lines.en: Something bright in the sand; I dig it out.
I drag it into my burrow.
I will drop it, but you must pay in meat.

lines.zh: 我的牙在它上面留了印。
lines.en: My teeth left marks on it.
I will line my burrow with this cloth.
A rabbit is behind the dune.

lines.zh: 一只鸡在刨土，没看见我。
lines.en: A chicken scratches, unaware of me.
I flatten down, belly against the sand.
My tail stops first.

lines.zh: 那点动静是羽毛的声音。
lines.en: That rustle is the sound of feathers.
I have worked out where it will hop.
The sand is soft; I have to creep.
Its shadow is short; the sun is high.
The one I watch is the fattest.

lines.zh: 舌头一伸一缩，是在试风。
lines.en: My tongue flicks in and out, tasting the wind.
Four steps still separate us.

lines.zh: 它扭头张望，我连眼都不眨。
lines.en: It turns to look; I do not even blink.
Nothing here but sand and stone.

lines.zh: 它离洞口还有段距离，我等。
lines.en: It is still shy of the burrow; I wait.
Feathers are shifting behind the thornbush.
I smell a chicken coop.

lines.zh: 这片崖壁下，兔子跑不远。
lines.en: Rabbits can't run far under this cliff.

lines.zh: 我先看它的腿，再看它的脖子。
lines.en: First its legs, then its neck.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面绕到它后面。
lines.en: I hug the ground and circle behind it.
It hops, and I rush forward.
Sand bursts out under my claws.
A short hiss rolls out of my throat.
It runs uphill; the slope is mine.

lines.zh: 我拐了个急弯，鳞片擦沙。
lines.en: I cut a hard turn, scales scraping sand.
It darts into the grass; I wait.
My eyes stay locked on it.

lines.zh: 距离够近了，我伏得更低。
lines.en: Close enough; I crouch even lower.

lines.zh: 上风头的味道告诉我它在动。
lines.en: The scent upwind tells me it is moving.

lines.zh: 我避开尖石，从侧面贴过去。
lines.en: I ease past the sharp stone on my flank.

lines.zh: 它听见了，回头看了一眼。
lines.en: It hears me and glances back.

lines.zh: 后腿蹬住沙，随时能弹出去。
lines.en: Hind legs braced on sand, ready to launch.
This pounce will not miss.

lines.zh: 我的肚皮压在热沙上，不响。
lines.en: My belly on hot sand makes no sound.

lines.zh: 我一步一步挪，沙子不漏。
lines.en: I creep step by step without shifting the sand.

lines.zh: 它停住了，我连尾巴都不动。
lines.en: It stops, so I don't even move my tail.

lines.zh: 谁碰我的骑手，我就竖起尾巴。
lines.en: Touch my rider and my tail goes up.

lines.zh: 我绕到下坡，那里它跑不快。
lines.en: I circle downhill, where it can't run fast.

lines.zh: 它开始挖洞，我就等那一瞬。
lines.en: It starts digging, so I wait for that moment.

lines.zh: 牙齿扣进它颈后的软皮。
lines.en: My teeth hook the soft skin behind its neck.

lines.zh: 我把它按在滚烫的沙上。
lines.en: I pin it against the burning sand.

lines.zh: 我的爪子先着地，压住它。
lines.en: My claws land first and press it down.
One whip of my tail knocks it over.
My teeth are small, but they grip hard.
It kicks twice, then goes slack.

lines.zh: 我咬住不放，甩头把它翻过来。
lines.en: I hold and whip my head to flip it over.
A few feathers are left in the sand.
I strike and recoil, wary of others.
The sand drinks the blood quickly.
While it still moves, I do not let go.
This bite lands at the wing joint.
I drag the kill into the rock's shadow.

lines.zh: 吃完我把嘴在沙上蹭干净。
lines.en: After eating I wipe my jaws on the sand.

lines.zh: 我扑上去，连着沙一起压。
lines.en: I pounce and press down sand and all.

lines.zh: 我的前爪勾住它的后腿。
lines.en: My foreclaws hook its hind legs.
I bite and jerk my head up.

lines.zh: 羽毛塞满我的嘴，我吐掉。
lines.en: Feathers fill my mouth, so I spit them out.

lines.zh: 我还想再咬一口，它已经不动了。
lines.en: I want another bite, but it's already still.

lines.zh: 这一下之后，我抖了抖鳞上的沙。
lines.en: After that, I shake the sand off my scales.

lines.zh: 沙面鼓起一堆，我从下面顶出来。
lines.en: The sand bulges, and I push up through it.

lines.zh: 太阳烤着我刚出来的背。
lines.en: The sun bakes my back as I emerge.

lines.zh: 这里是沙漠边缘的干湖。
lines.en: This is a dry lake at the desert's edge.

lines.zh: 我第一眼看到的是红岩。
lines.en: The first thing I see is red rock.
Wind blows sand into my nostrils.
I find a rock crevice and slip inside.
The dunes here roll very gently.

lines.zh: 我抬头，天上一只鸟都没有。
lines.en: I look up; not a single bird in the sky.

lines.zh: 我闻到了兔子洞的味道。
lines.en: I smell the scent of a rabbit burrow.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴在沙上打了个圈。
lines.en: My tail sweeps a ring in the sand.
This place is so dry. I like it.
I start crawling toward the shade.
Hot! My scales are all curling up.

lines.zh: 我从岩上滑下，摔进沙里。
lines.en: I slide off the rock and land in the sand.
The lake is shallow, but I cannot swim.

lines.zh: 沙被掀起来，我埋了半截。
lines.en: Sand heaves up and half-buries me.
The arrow's fletching still quivers in my back.

lines.zh: 那种怪味让我的腿发软。
lines.en: That strange reek makes my legs weak.

lines.zh: 沙里没兔子，我饿得发慌。
lines.en: No rabbits in the sand; I am frantic with hunger.

lines.zh: 雷打在沙上，我的鳞全麻。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the sand and my scales go numb.

lines.zh: 下面没有沙，我抓不住任何东西。
lines.en: No sand below; my claws catch nothing.
